image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a Brambling (Fringilla montifringilla), standing on snowy ground. The bird exhibits winter plumage with a brownish-grey head and back, an orange-rufous breast, and white underparts. It has a short, conical yellow bill with a dark tip. The wings show black feathers with distinct white bars. The legs are pinkish-brown with visible toes gripping the snow surface.
